d:
The Hawks defeated the Pacers, 108-104 tonight in Indiana. Nickeil Alexander-Walker contributed a team-high 34 points to go with 9 three pointers 4 rebounds and 4 steals, with Luguentz Dort of the Hawks adding an additional 14 points (5-10 FG, 4-6 3P) in the game. Jay Huff finished with a team-high 22 points along with 8 rebounds for the Pacers in the losing effort. The Hawks improve their record to 4-4 with the win, while the Pacers fall to 2-6 for the season.
